name: Tender and Procurement Assistant
notes: Scores four sample supplier submissions against weighted criteria on open, lets the panel adjust scores in a live comparison matrix, and drafts evaluation comments, a recommendation summary, supplier clarification requests and specification outlines, with AI where available and rules otherwise (assumes an RFQ-style lump-sum evaluation; operator and mechanic assessments are not covered). Reviewed for the brief and manager ready.
desc: Compares supplier submissions against weighted tender criteria in a scoring matrix the panel can adjust, then drafts evaluation comments, a recommendation summary and clarification requests. It also drafts specification outlines for new RFQs.
tested: Playwright at 1280x800 light and 390x844 dark: opens with rule-based scores and a ranked matrix, score edit updates totals, rank and the stale-comments note, clarification request and comments and outline Copy buttons copy to the clipboard with Draft in Outlook beside each, reset button, specification validation and sample brief, no console or page errors, scrollWidth equals viewport, no en or em dashes in visible text including the productionise panel, Steps to productionise opens, All AI prototypes shows, keyboard focus ring visible. AI stand-in: assessment JSON normalised and quotes checked, text cleaned of dashes and markdown, names, emails, phones and addresses absent from all three prompts, AI failure shows Try again and template fallback.
